method: Merge raw findings from 8 sources (profiler LOCAL, static SAST, pattern-matcher, code/Tier-2, econ/Tier-2, faithfulness, Tier-3 invariant/fuzz, Tier-3 symbolic) by ROOT CAUSE. One unique root cause = one consolidated finding, carrying all corroborating source IDs, the empirical Tier-3 verification status, contract:function:line, and a severity hypothesis (highest among merged, with adjudicated level noted). Faithfulness (F-XX) tags preserved on merged security findings. Only TRUE tool-noise filtered. Ledger relations annotated for the downstream sanitizer; this stage does NOT perform ledger reconciliation.

verificationLegend.CONFIRMED: Tier-3 reproduced a counterexample (forge deterministic / forge invariant / medusa property / halmos symbolic).

consolidatedFindings.title: "Linear Depletion" is implemented as exponential decay: rewardPerSecond is re-anchored to remainingBalance/depletionDuration on every interaction, so a funding tranche delivers only ~63% within its window and the tail stalls
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: rewardPerSecond = (rewardBalance * PRECISION) / depletionDuration is recomputed AFTER every non-zero distribution inside _updatePool (and again in collectReward and setDepletionDuration), re-anchoring the full depletion window on every poke. Continuous dynamics become dB/dt = -B/D (exponential decay B0*e^(-t/D)) instead of the intended linear payout over depletionDuration.

consolidatedFindings.title: Partial pauseWithdraw leaves reward debt anchored to the larger pre-withdraw amount -> next claim/withdraw/stake underflow-reverts, bricking the account's normal paths (principal recoverable only by re-pausing)
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: pauseWithdraw decrements user.amount (L251) and totalStaked (L254) WITHOUT calling _updatePool and WITHOUT rebasing user.phUSDDebt/user.stableDebt. It is the one balance-mutating path that breaks INV-5 (debt reset on every amount change). After a partial exit, _claimRewards computes (smaller amount)*accX/PRECISION - (debt sized for larger amount) -> checked-arithmetic underflow (Panic 0x11) under 0.8.19.

consolidatedFindings.verificationDetail: Deterministic PoC: stake 1000e18 -> collectReward -> claim -> pause -> pauseWithdraw(500e18) -> unpause -> claim() & withdraw() both panic 0x11. forge invariant_CODE002_no_pending_underflow FAIL; medusa property_no_pending_underflow FAIL; halmos ClaimRewardsUnderflowSymbolic FAIL (witness amount0=100e18, 81.92% pulled).

consolidatedFindings.title: CEI violation: stake/withdraw/claim settle reward debt AFTER phUSD.mint / rewardToken.transfer and carry no nonReentrant -> token-callback re-entry would N-claim the same accrual (phUSD over-mint + reward drain)
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: _claimRewards performs external calls phUSD.mint (L442) and rewardToken.safeTransfer (L448) BEFORE the callers (stake/withdraw/claim) write user.phUSDDebt/user.stableDebt. Only collectReward is nonReentrant (inconsistent-guard tell). A re-entrant claim before debt is rebased recomputes the same pending and mints/transfers it again.

consolidatedFindings.title: Permissionless collectReward (and free non-staker claim() poke) lets anyone re-anchor rewardPerSecond at gas-only cost, forcing worst-case exponential decay and stalling the stable-reward tail
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: collectReward is permissionless (only require: amount>0) and re-anchors rewardPerSecond = rewardBalance*PRECISION/depletionDuration (L283); additionally claim() runs _updatePool() unconditionally before _claimRewards early-returns for a non-staker, so a non-staker can poke the re-anchor (L416) for GAS ONLY. Because delivered = 1-(1-T/(N*D))^N is decreasing in poke count N, an unprivileged actor can pin realized delivery to the e^(-t/D) floor (~63% at t=D) and strand the dust tail.
alsoAt: claim L374-381 -> _updatePool poke (free, no token cost, no MINIMUM_STAKE gate)
_updatePool L425 advances lastRewardTime even when toDistribute floors to 0 (tail-stall)

consolidatedFindings.title: pause -> pauseWithdraw -> unpause over-mints phUSD: pauseWithdraw shrinks totalStaked without refreshing phUSDPerSecond or advancing lastRewardTime, so the next accrual mints at the pre-pause (larger) rate spread over the smaller stake
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: pauseWithdraw decrements totalStaked (L254) but does NOT call _updatePool/_updatePhUSDEmissionRate and does NOT advance lastRewardTime. phUSDPerSecond stays sized for the pre-pause totalStaked S0. On unpause, the first _updatePool credits the entire paused interval at the stale rate r0 over the reduced totalStaked S1 -> extra_phUSD = (S0-S1)*Tp*APYbps/(10000*SECONDS_PER_YEAR); effective APY inflated by factor S0/S1. phUSD is minted (no balance cap), so this is direct supply inflation. claim() never refreshes the rate, prolonging it.
mergedSources: LOCAL-003 (pause does not freeze accrual; stale phUSDPerSecond -> over-emission)
ECON-003 (quantified over-mint model + worked examples; net-new vs ledger)

consolidatedFindings.verificationDetail: Deterministic: S0=2000e18, S1=1000e18, pause 7d, apyBps=1000 -> minted 3.8356e18 vs fair cap 1.9178e18, overMintFactor 2.0 == S0/S1. forge test_ECON003_property_noOverMint + invariant_ECON003_no_over_mint FAIL; medusa property_no_over_mint FAIL (shrunk: stake/pause/pauseWithdraw/pause/unpause/withdraw).
consolidatedFindings.severityReasoning: C4 Medium: quantifiable, mint-backed (uncapped) phUSD inflation under a stated external requirement (pauser-gated pause + a partial pauseWithdraw + unpause). Not High: gated on a trusted pause event and per-cycle magnitude bounded by (S0-S1)*Tp*APY. Likelihood lowered because the live deployment is documented as expecting zero-APY operation (zero-APY immunizes this stream); kept Medium because with non-zero APY the inflation is direct and non-obvious to a non-malicious operator (Law-3 footgun).
consolidatedFindings.lawMapping: Law 2 (story-006/INV-7 regression) + Law 3 (non-obvious operator footgun) + Law 1 (supply inflation).
consolidatedFindings.ledgerRelation: Appears NET-NEW: distinct from ledger M-01 (claim revert), L-06 (exiting user forfeits accrual), and the C-04/L-05 selective-yield-denial. This is the OVER-MINT to REMAINING stakers. Amplified by DEDUP-007 (LOCAL-005 dust drives S1->0, maximizing S0/S1).

consolidatedFindings.title: setPauser(0) + emergencyTransfer permanently bricks ALL withdrawals: contract is force-paused with no valid unpauser, the pauseWithdraw escape is drained dead, and userInfo/totalStaked are never zeroed (owner footgun)
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: Three individually-reasonable facts compose into an unrecoverable state: (1) setPauser(address(0)) is documented as the way to 'disable pausing'; (2) emergencyTransfer sweeps the entire phUSD + rewardToken balances and then calls _pause() UNCONDITIONALLY (L226); (3) unpause() requires msg.sender==pauser (L198). With pauser==0, unpause can never succeed -> permanent pause; stake/withdraw/claim (whenNotPaused) revert forever; the only whenPaused escape pauseWithdraw reverts because phUSD was drained to 0; accounting is never zeroed.

NON-obvious -- hence reportable -- is that the documented 'disable pausing' setting turns emergencyTransfer's auto-pause into a PERMANENT lock that also kills the pauseWithdraw escape and leaves accounting non-zeroed.

consolidatedFindings.title: FAITHFULNESS: emergencyTransfer breaks story-008 HIGH-5's promise that users can 'safely exit via pauseWithdraw' after a drain -- post-drain pauseWithdraw reverts for everyone
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: story-008 HIGH-5 (d46506a) states users get a usable pauseWithdraw exit after emergencyTransfer. But emergencyTransfer moves the ENTIRE phUSD balance (== totalStaked, INV-2) out, then pauses; pauseWithdraw then does phUSD.safeTransfer (L257) against a zero balance and reverts for every user. The advertised on-chain recovery path does not exist after an emergencyTransfer (pauseWithdraw is only coherent after a plain pause()).
mergedSources: F-002 (FAITHFULNESS-only deviation; story-008 HIGH-5 recovery guarantee mislabelled)
consolidatedFindings.verificationDetail: Spec-conformance deviation; not a counterexample target. High confidence from code reading: phUSD balance == 0 post-drain makes pauseWithdraw's safeTransfer revert.
consolidatedFindings.severityReasoning: Law-2 faithfulness-only: the drain itself is a knowing owner action (Law-3 trusted) and the intended real-world flow (story-049: emergencyTransfer(owner) then off-chain redistribution) routes principal to the trusted owner, so no protocol value loss -- only a false on-chain-recovery claim. The harmful manifestation is the DEDUP-006 footgun.
consolidatedFindings.lawMapping: Law 2 (story contradiction). Feeds the spec-conformance report; escalates to the security manifestation DEDUP-006.
consolidatedFindings.ledgerRelation: Context for ledger C-02 / DEDUP-006. Also surfaced as manualReview PATTERN-ML-003 (centralization framing).

consolidatedFindings.title: Stable reward stranding via per-share rounding: rewardBalance is debited in full while accStablePerShare floors, so the floored remainder is removed from rewardBalance without ever being credited to any share
consolidatedFindings.rootCause: In _updatePool, rewardBalance -= toDistribute (full) but accStablePerShare += (toDistribute*PRECISION)/totalStaked floors (L409-417). The floored remainder leaves rewardBalance uncredited to any share -> permanently stranded stable tokens (recoverable only via emergencyTransfer). Bounded < totalStaked/PRECISION + 1 wei per update, but accumulates -- amplified by the frequent small updates DEDUP-001/DEDUP-004 induce.
